title: Enhancement of endometrial receptivity by Bushen Zhuyun Decoction via cryptotanshinone-mediated TRIM28 induction and HIF-1alpha suppression.
authors: Tang, Xingran; Zhao, Huijin; Ding, Yinyin; Qin, Yajie; Yang, Xiaotian; Jiang, Xiaoyue; Zhou, Huifang; Liu, Bei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药方剂通过TRIM28和HIF-1alpha调节子宫内膜容受性，属于纯湿实验和药理学机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Bushen Zhuyun Decoction (BSZYD), a traditional Chinese remedy, has demonstrated clinical efficacy in the treatment of luteal phase deficiency (LPD), though its mechanistic pathways remain largely undefined. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to elucidate the mechanism by which BSZYD enhances endometrial receptivity. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In an LPD rat model induced by RU-486 and treated with BSZYD, molecular markers of endometrial receptivity were evaluated using scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Furthermore, these markers were analyzed in the RL95-2 human adenocarcinoma cell line following knockdown of Tripartite motif containing 28 (TRIM28). Network pharmacology and UPLC-MS/MS were utilized to identify bioactive components that modulate Hypoxia-inducible factor-1 (HIF-1) signaling, followed by validation through molecular docking. The interaction between HIF-1alpha and TRIM28 was assessed using co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and confocal microscopy. The effect of cryptotanshinone on TRIM28 expression was also examined in RL95-2 cells. RESULTS: BSZYD significantly increased the number of embryo implantation sites and reduced endometrial reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels in LPD rats. TRIM28 was found to be crucial for BSZYD's enhancement of endometrial receptivity. Cryptotanshinone, a key component of BSZYD, downregulated HIF-1alpha expression in RL95-2 cells. The interaction between HIF-1alpha and TRIM28 was confirmed both in vivo and in vitro. In vitro, cryptotanshinone mitigated H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative stress. Furthermore, HIF-1alpha agonist administration attenuated BSZYD's ability to induce TRIM28 expression. CONCLUSIONS: BSZYD and its bioactive constituent, cryptotanshinone, promote endometrial receptivity by inhibiting HIF-1alpha and upregulating TRIM28. These findings offer novel molecular targets and pharmacological insights for the prevention and treatment of LPD.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：补肾助孕方（BSZYD）作为一种传统中药，在治疗黄体功能不全（LPD）方面已显示出临床疗效，但其机制途径在很大程度上仍未明确。研究目的：本研究旨在阐明BSZYD增强子宫内膜容受性的机制。材料与方法：在RU-486诱导的LPD大鼠模型中，经BSZYD治疗后，使用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）评估子宫内膜容受性的分子标志物。此外，在三重基序蛋白28（TRIM28）敲低后，分析了RL95-2人腺癌细胞系中的这些标志物。利用网络药理学和UPLC-MS/MS鉴定调节缺氧诱导因子-1（HIF-1）信号通路的生物活性成分，并通过分子对接进行验证。使用共免疫沉淀（Co-IP）和共聚焦显微镜评估HIF-1α与TRIM28之间的相互作用。同时，在RL95-2细胞中检测了隐丹参酮对TRIM28表达的影响。结果：BSZYD显著增加了LPD大鼠胚胎着床位点的数量，并降低了子宫内膜活性氧（ROS）水平。发现TRIM28对BSZYD增强子宫内膜容受性至关重要。隐丹参酮作为BSZYD的关键成分，下调了RL95-2细胞中HIF-1α的表达。HIF-1α与TRIM28之间的相互作用在体内和体外均得到确认。在体外，隐丹参酮减轻了H(2)O(2)诱导的氧化应激。此外，给予HIF-1α激动剂减弱了BSZYD诱导TRIM28表达的能力。结论：BSZYD及其生物活性成分隐丹参酮通过抑制HIF-1α和上调TRIM28来促进子宫内膜容受性。这些发现为LPD的预防和治疗提供了新的分子靶点和药理学见解。
